title: Exclude optional BDD examples from SDK-free core discovery
acceptance_criteria: AC6: Only the explicitly classified BDD example subtree is excluded from SDK-free project discovery; core and unclassified projects still fail.
AC7: Project and example changes select the SDK-free contract, and default framework validation remains SDK-free.

results.summary: Implemented exact BDD example subtree exclusion and project-change selection. Host focused exclusion and all 11 registry tests pass; clean-checkout SDK inventory and independent review remain pending.
